name: g6-hold
purpose: G6: an allowed-side / held-side pair on one sandbox. 50 to sam (at or under the approval line of 100) must pay at once; 150 to sam (over the line) must be held, nothing moves, and the guard says it is pending; 30 to ada after it must pay at once. A guard that holds or refuses the under-the-line payments cannot validate the approval rule.
